edition.title: Split-Zero cohomology: arithmetic volume estimates and shared quotient geometry
edition.scope: Complete analytic continuations for finite full-multiplicity xi-zero packets in the original theta-source quotient: Gamma source-order comparison and equilibrium refinement, original connecting and invariant quotient geometry, nested-flag spectral threshold estimates, complete arithmetic action, uniform contraction and sharp canonical-band penalty tails. All original masses, units, zero orders, relation fibres, phases, mixed pairings and coordinate maps are retained. Correlated allocation terms cancel in the complete arithmetic action; fixed proportional degree-window results and the distinct root-sensitive growing-degree continuation are identified separately. No proof or disproof of RH, observed off-critical zero, or numerical evaluation of the remaining actual-period spectra is claimed.
edition.verification_scope: The final owner acceptance supplies the exact cumulative source, reader identities, page count, mathematical-review scope and visual-review receipt. Previously accepted proof and PDF reviews are reused at those identities, not represented as repeated work. PR37 received an independent written proof review and a bounded checker replay: both Python modes passed, all eight deliberate-failure controls failed as intended, and all ten evidence manifests validated. High-precision diagnostics remain non-interval. Public packaging checks exact mathematical-body preservation, archive membership and standalone restoration of the public current source. Private conversation and email provenance may be explicitly withheld with hashes retained; this is not a claim to reconstruct withheld private historical bytes. No new Lean execution or actual arithmetic-packet numerical certification is claimed.
